map.对每个生精小管横切面评分(1-10)，求平均 Johnsen 评分: Score each seminiferous tubule cross-section (1-10) to obtain the mean Johnsen score

map.完全生精（各级生精细胞+精子）: Complete spermatogenesis (all germ cell stages + sperm)
map.提示：活检为局灶性评估，不能完全代表全睾丸状态。NOA 患者多区取材(mTESE: Tip: biopsy is a focal assessment and cannot fully represent the entire testicular state. For NOA patients, multi-region sampling (mTESE) can improve sperm retrieval rate. For learning reference only.
map.平均 7 分 → 生精减低下但有精子，可尝试显微取精（micro-TESE）。: Mean 7: reduced spermatogenesis but sperm present, micro-TESE can be attempted.
map.仅支持细胞/精原，生精严重障碍，取精成功率低，需充分告知。: Sertoli-cell-only / spermatogonia, severe spermatogenic disorder, low retrieval success, requires full informed consent.
map.均 1–10 分系统，Silber 更简；本器支持两式并给出分级描述。: Both are 1-10 systems; Silber is simpler; this tool supports both and gives grading descriptions.
map.非梗阻性无精子症靠 micro-TESE 找局灶生精，评分高成功率更高。: Non-obstructive azoospermia relies on micro-TESE to find focal spermatogenesis; higher score means higher success.
